name: Noticky
soft_passes: #4 16px squint: reads as a yellow blob on black = still a sticky note, but fold/tilt/ruled-lines smear; carried by luminance contrast not shape detail
#9 era coherence: pure Big-Sur devices (squircle, flat matte front object, fold shadow) but the pure-black field and emissive glow are a moody dialect adjacent to a custom reading
failures: #10 variant robustness: fixed Big-Sur raster, not Icon-Composer glass layers; identity is colour-locked yellow-on-black with no fg/bg separation, so no system-generated clear/tinted variants (dark-mode only coincidentally OK because the field is already black)

palette.background: flat #000000 (corners), warm-olive glow bleed #12130B->#2B2B0A in a ~60px halo around the note

light_model: self-illuminated / emissive: the note glows and blooms a warm halo into pure black rather than receiving a top-down key; one small internal cast shadow under the peeled corner flap; single coherent model
layer_stack: flat yellow note plane with engraved ruled lines
peeled top-left corner flap + its cast shadow
devices: glowing note on a black stage (emissive, product-thesis: always-on-top/visible-in-the-dark)
peeled top-left corner + ~11deg tilt = instant 'sticky note' read
engraved ruled lines suggesting text with zero letters
dark-field inversion of a conventionally-bright subject
rhymes_hint: dark-field single-luminous-object icons (one bright element glowing on near-black; shares staging with Backdrop's droplet though this object is flat/matte not glass) and flat-matte object-on-field Big-Sur paper/note icons; possible 'dark-stage / self-lit object' family, not yet a >=3-icon cluster
notes: 512x512 PNG web render (masters at 1024); RGB conversion flattened transparency to black and because the field IS black the true mask edges can't be isolated, only that art sits well inside the mask. Note optically dead-centre: bbox 150-366 x 144-367, centre (258,255) vs canvas (256,256), ~42% canvas width. Body fill is near-uniform flat #F9D110 (minimal gradient). NOT Liquid Glass: no translucency/refraction/specular/layer separation. Adjacent honest era read = custom (dark-stage). Tight brand coherence: same yellow across icon, black+yellow wordmark, and hero note; app uses a multi-colour note set but the icon commits to yellow.
